title: field-wallet-escrow-and-receipts-ledger
content:
Purpose / quick summary:
- Lightweight field wallet (escrow) protocol for demo days / conference pop-ups. Single-page cheat for staff who will carry event petty cash and hand off receipts. Lower friction than formal company card workflows for same-day vendor reimbursements.

Principles:
- Two-person custody when cash > $250.
- Every expense needs a photo of the receipt + a short note (merchant, what it covered, who paid).
- Tag expenses to one of: travel, meals, booth-supplies, hardware, misc.
- Reconcile within 48h after event end — faster means faster reimbursement to staff.

Field wallet roles (day team):
- Custodian (primary): person who physically carries the wallet and pays.
- Auditor (secondary): spot-checks receipts, signs when transfer occurs, submits to finance.
- Handoff owner: coordinates transfers between shifts/people, keeps timestamped log.

Day-of flow (fast):
1) Before shift: open wallet log (paper inside zip sleeve) and add start balance, custodian name, phone.
2) When paying vendor: take photo of receipt (phone camera), add 1-line note in camera caption: "merchant — what — attendee count (if meal)".
3) If receipt small/loose (coffee), ask for merchant name on napkin/card or add note for card last4.
4) Auditor signs physical receipt and writes time. If cash transfer > $250, both Custodian + Auditor sign the handoff line.
5) End of shift: gather receipts, transfer photos + notes to the shared folder (Events -> Receipts -> yyyy-mm-dd-eventname). Rename photos to: 2025-10-08_merchant_amt_currency_custodian.jpg
6) Handoff owner uploads CSV ledger (template below) and pings #events-field-ops.

Ledger template (one-line per expense) — CSV headers used by finance: date,merchant,amount,currency,category,paid_by,custodian,notes,receipt_file
Example row: 2025-10-08,Corner Deli,42.50,USD,meals,cash,Asha Patel,"team breakfast for 4",2025-10-08_cornerdeli_42.50_usd_asha.jpg

Per-diem / caps to remember:
- Individual meal per-diem: $65/day domestic (breakfast/lunch/dinner combined).
- Small supplies: up to $200 fine from wallet per item; anything >$200 needs pre-approval (Slack @events-leads).
- Taxis/ride-shares: prefer card/ride app; reimburse with receipt + rider name. If paid in cash, note trip start/end and route.

Vendor contacts (day-of priority) — quick dial/email (do not store secure creds here):
- Rapid Rentals — point contact: Priya Menon, priya@rapidrentals.co, +1-415-555-0124 — extra tables, stands, same-day delivery.
- BoothBite Catering — Samir K., samir@boothbite.com, +1-628-555-0199 — order window 24–48h before.
- Local AV — Northside AV Ops, avops@northsideav.io, +1-206-555-0170 — mic checks only (arrive 90m before).
- Onsite Courier — QuickDrop Logistics, ops@quickdrop.io, +1-800-555-0111 — badge pickup/shuttle for crates.

Common receipt/photo gotchas (how to get an approvable photo quickly):
- If receipt is thermal and fading, press it flat on a dark surface and take top-down shot, use phone flash.
- For handwritten totals (vendor stalls), capture full stall/front and crop later; include vendor business card if possible.
- If merchant provides emailed receipt, forward to receipts+events@redwood.com with subject: [event yyyy-mm-dd] merchant amount custodian

Reimbursement path (post-event):
- Handoff owner compiles CSV + zipped receipts, drops into Confluence attachment (Events->ExpensePackages) or uploads to finance portal link (Finance case ID required).
- Finance will process petty reimbursements within 5 business days after submission. For anything flagged, finance will ping original custodian.

Open questions / TODOs for next ops sync:
- Should we standardize local-currency rounding policy? (e.g., round up to nearest whole USD at submission).
- Add QR receipt scanner automation to push photos into the ledger folder with metadata? Work with DevTools for simple zap.
- Can we pre-pay small catering via company card to avoid cash touch? Ops to check vendor acceptance.

Notes to self (practical):
- Pack: zip sleeve with paper log, 2x Sharpies, 1x receipt organizer envelope, spare rubber bands, printed vendor contacts, spare business cards.
- Bring one extra staff phone charger — we will be taking a lot of photos.

Quick checklist (day-before):
- [ ] Confirm pick-up window with Rapid Rentals (Priya).
- [ ] Confirm catering headcount with BoothBite — add vegetarian count.
- [ ] Load event folder template and share with custodian.
- [ ] Prepare cash float: count in front of Auditor, both sign.

Misc shorthand logs (examples to paste into ledger rows):
- "booth tape + 2x gaff rolls" (category: booth-supplies)
- "client coffee — intro meeting w/ 3" (category: meals)
- "mic plug + patch fee" (category: av)

If anything ambiguous: take the photo, put a short note, and escalate on Slack (#events-field-ops). Better to capture imperfect info than nothing.

Revision history:

- 2025-10-10 clarified two-person custody rule and upload naming convention
